intro: This errand sends travelers across the sea from the salt pans of Kalimdor to the steaming jungles of Stranglethorn Vale. Kravel Koalbeard, an opportunistic merchant at the Mirage Raceway, tasks adventurers with delivering a long-overdue package of specialty supplies to the renowned big-game hunter Hemet Nesingwary.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.
I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, friend. No, of course not. I would think better of you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmmm, not bad, friend. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.
Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
